messages.previous: Cases / Resolutions
messages.approved: Action Required
messages.reason: This view will include every current human-action payment issue, not only finance resolutions. No case action is removed.

messages.previous: No Case Resolutions match the current Banking Pay filters.
messages.approved: No payments requiring action match the current Banking Pay filters.
messages.reason: Matches the wider Action Required meaning and keeps current filter behaviour.

messages.previous: No cases need resolution.
messages.approved: No payments currently need action.
messages.reason: Plain zero state for the wider task list.

messages.previous: Payment route, candidate and client filters intersect across Ready to Pay, Blocked for Pay and Case Resolutions. Hidden selections are preserved, but hidden rows are never drafted.
messages.approved: Payment route, candidate and client filters apply to Ready to pay, Action Required and Blocked for Pay. Selections outside the current filters remain saved, but those payments cannot be included in this Draft.
messages.reason: Removes intersect and updates the renamed view without weakening the Draft safety rule.

messages.previous: Choose Ready to Pay rows, then create a draft.
messages.approved: Choose the candidates to include, then create a Draft.
messages.reason: The main user action is now candidate selection. Payment-level selection remains in Candidate Banking.

messages.previous: Amount
messages.approved: Ready to pay
messages.reason: The column shows the current selected payment display amount. It does not claim to be PAYE net or final bank-out.

messages.previous: Amount {amount}
messages.approved: Ready to pay £{amount}
messages.reason: Makes the headline meaning explicit. The value must come from the full-session selected amount, not the current visible-page Amount.

messages.previous: {number} selected
messages.approved: {number} candidates included
messages.reason: The main count is candidate-based. The underlying payment selection is unchanged.

messages.previous: {selected}/{available} on this page
messages.approved: {selected} of {available} candidates on this page included
messages.reason: Removes ambiguity about whether the numbers are candidates or payment lines.

messages.previous: Tick all Ready to Pay lines
messages.approved: Include all eligible payments for every candidate
messages.reason: Used as the global checkbox label/tooltip. It still invokes the current server-owned all-page Ready selection.

messages.previous: Untick all Ready to Pay lines
messages.approved: Remove all eligible payments for every candidate
messages.reason: Used as the global clear label/tooltip. Remove means remove from this pay run, not delete payment records.

messages.previous: No payable rows found.
messages.approved: No candidates currently have payments ready to include.
messages.reason: Candidate-based, plain empty state.

messages.previous: No line-level items are currently ready to pay.
messages.approved: No candidates currently have payments ready to include.
messages.reason: Removes line-level technical language.

messages.previous: No Ready to Pay rows match the current Banking Pay filters.
messages.approved: No candidates with payments ready to include match the current Banking Pay filters.
messages.reason: Correct full-result filtered empty state.

messages.previous: No rows are blocked for pay.
messages.approved: No payments are currently blocked.
messages.reason: Uses the object the user understands: payments, not rows.

messages.previous: No Blocked for Pay rows match the current Banking Pay filters.
messages.approved: No blocked payments match the current Banking Pay filters.
messages.reason: Keeps the same filters and removes table-language jargon.

messages.previous: New candidate-level field; no current candidate Deductions label
messages.approved: Deductions
messages.reason: Exact new column name. Its value is Yes or a neutral dash only.

messages.previous: New candidate-level value; no current equivalent
messages.approved: Yes
messages.reason: Show only when at least one currently selected Ready payment is canonically a deduction.

messages.previous: New candidate-level value; no current equivalent
messages.reason: Show when no currently selected Ready payment is canonically a deduction. Do not show No, because the candidate may have an unselected or blocked deduction elsewhere.

messages.previous: No current no-Timesheet tooltip
messages.approved: No Ready Timesheet is linked to this candidate's selected payments.
messages.reason: Used only if the design keeps a neutral disabled Timesheets icon. Never open a broad candidate Timesheets search.

messages.previous: Insufficient funds
messages.approved: Insufficient funds to deduct
messages.reason: The current label is incomplete. The new label tells the user what cannot happen. The underlying NO_PAY_HEADROOM reason remains unchanged.

messages.previous: No credit balance to deduct
messages.approved: Insufficient funds to deduct
messages.reason: Credit balance is accounting language and does not explain the practical effect.

messages.previous: No available funds to recover this yet.
messages.approved: There is not enough pay available in this run to make this deduction.
messages.reason: Removes yet and states exactly why the deduction is not happening in this pay run.

messages.previous: No unreserved payable earnings are available for this recovery.
messages.approved: There is not enough pay available in this run to make this deduction.
messages.reason: Removes unreserved payable earnings, which is accurate internally but not user-friendly. The scheduled amount and amount deductible now remain separately displayed.

messages.previous: Scheduled recovery due
messages.approved: Deduction scheduled for this pay run
messages.reason: Keeps the scheduled figure distinct from what can actually be deducted now.

messages.previous: Recoverable this pay run: {amount}
messages.approved: Can be deducted now: £{amount}
messages.reason: Plain wording; the server still owns the amount.

messages.previous: No recovery can be made because there are no available funds to deduct from this pay run.
messages.approved: This deduction cannot be made because there is not enough pay available in this run.
messages.reason: Shorter and specific. No change to the outstanding amount or blocked state.

messages.previous: {recoverable} will be recovered from the total outstanding amount of {outstanding}.
messages.approved: £{recoverable} will be deducted in this pay run. £{outstanding} is still outstanding before this deduction.
messages.reason: Separates the amount taken now from the outstanding balance and avoids a long accounting sentence. Values remain server supplied.

messages.previous: No recovery can be made this pay run from the total outstanding amount of {outstanding}.
messages.approved: Nothing can be deducted in this pay run. £{outstanding} remains outstanding.
messages.reason: Direct, specific zero-deduction explanation.

messages.previous: PAYE > UMBR
messages.approved: Payment was originally PAYE. Candidate is now paid through an umbrella company.
messages.reason: Removes an abbreviation and arrow that require interpretation. This text must be derived from the current source and target methods.

messages.previous: This amount is currently determined as PAYE and needs resolution to convert it to Umbrella.
messages.approved: Payment was originally PAYE. Candidate is now paid through an umbrella company. Choose how this payment should be handled.
messages.reason: States what changed and what the user must do. The existing taxable restructure action and calculation remain unchanged.

messages.previous: UMBR > PAYE
messages.approved: Payment was originally through an umbrella company. Candidate is now PAYE.
messages.reason: Clear reverse direction with no abbreviation.

messages.previous: This amount is currently determined as Umbrella and needs resolution to convert it to PAYE.
messages.approved: Payment was originally through an umbrella company. Candidate is now PAYE. Choose how this payment should be handled.
messages.reason: Clear reverse source-to-target explanation.

messages.approved: Payment method changed
messages.reason: A specific task title is more useful than a generic red badge. The full source-to-target sentence follows it.

messages.previous: Resolution required, when a rate must be chosen
messages.approved: Rate decision required
messages.reason: The existing Suggested Rate, Accept suggestion and Manual rate controls remain.

messages.previous: Resolution required, when an amount must be chosen
messages.approved: Amount decision required
messages.reason: The existing Suggested Gross Total and Manual amount controls remain.

messages.approved: Original rate

messages.reason: Explains what CloudTMS is doing and avoids telling the user to repeatedly refresh.

messages.previous: Payee setup failed
messages.approved: Bank account setup failed
messages.reason: Plain task/status name.

messages.previous: Umbrella inactive
messages.approved: Umbrella company inactive

messages.approved: Account name check required.

messages.previous: Bank/name check could not be completed. Review before accepting.

messages.previous: Bank/name check failed. Review before accepting.
messages.approved: The account name does not match the bank details. Check both before accepting them.
messages.reason: Specific FAIL explanation and next step.

messages.previous: Bank/name check passed and the bank account has been set up. Banking Pay will refresh this candidate now.
messages.approved: The account name matches and this bank account is ready for payment. Banking Pay is updating the candidate now.
messages.reason: Plain success message; current refresh remains.

messages.previous: Bank/name check completed and needs review. Banking Pay will refresh this candidate now.
messages.approved: The account name check is complete. Review the result before this payment can be included. Banking Pay is updating the candidate now.
messages.reason: Explains why it is still Action Required. The detailed result must say fail, close match or unavailable.

messages.previous: Bank/name check has been submitted. Banking Pay will refresh this candidate now.
messages.approved: The account name check has started. This payment will update automatically when the result is ready.

messages.previous: Bank account setup required.
messages.approved: Bank account needs setting up.
messages.reason: Plain state label.

messages.previous: Please confirm a reason for accepting this bank-name mismatch. This is auditable and will prevent this mismatch from blocking drafts for these bank details.
messages.approved: Enter why you are accepting this account-name mismatch. The reason will be saved in the audit history. These exact bank details will no longer block Draft creation.
messages.reason: Preserves mandatory reason, exact bank-details scope and audit trail.

messages.previous: Review required.
messages.approved: Payment issue not identified
messages.reason: A generic review instruction does not say what to review. This title is used only for a genuinely unknown reason and the explanation below must accompany it.

messages.previous: A raw blocker code with underscores replaced by spaces
messages.approved: CloudTMS could not identify why this payment is blocked. It will not be included. Refresh Banking Pay; if it remains blocked, contact support.
messages.reason: Keep the raw code in diagnostics, not as user wording. The item remains visible, counted and fail-closed.

messages.previous: This case is currently blocked and needs review before it can move to Ready to Pay.
messages.approved: Show the exact server-published reason and what must change. If neither is available: CloudTMS could not identify why this payment is blocked. It will not be included. Refresh Banking Pay; if it remains blocked, contact support.
messages.reason: Removes a vague catch-all. No blocked item is hidden.

messages.previous: This timesheet segment is currently blocked for pay.
messages.approved: Show the exact Timesheet reason. If it is unavailable: This Timesheet payment cannot be included because CloudTMS could not confirm its current status. Open the Timesheet or refresh Banking Pay.
messages.reason: Requires a specific reason while retaining exact Timesheets navigation and fail-closed state.
